notes.title: Update v0.5.3b: Player Reworks & Balance Changes
notes.content:
Hey Everyone,

This update introduces a number of player reworks and balance changes. The main highlights are reworks for Tyreze Habiburtun, Alpen Sengoon, Mikael Bridgez, Cody Whide, Ougee Anuoby, Benn Simonz & Andreu Wyggins, as well as minor but impactful changes for Vik Wobamyama, Cabe Cuningham, Nicola Jokeric & Paszcal Siacam.


[h1]Passive Changes[/h1]
Accuracy bonus for Clutch Scorer, Center Specialist & Rim Runner has been reduced from 20% to 10%.
[i]These were too strong and had a disproportionate impact on the game.[/i]

[h1]Player Changes[/h1]

[i]While this seems like a small chance, the addition of Turn Meter on team block will significantly increase Cabe's performance, as it should enable him to get 1-2 extra activations per match in a block deck.[/i]

[i]A much needed rework for Mikael. While his old skill seemed strong, the fact that he activated late made it nearly useless, as most the opposing team had already used their shots. notes.title: Update v0.5.3: Daily Reward & New PvE Challenges
notes.content:
Hey Everyone,

This update focuses on improving the new player experience and introducing new PvE content.

[list]
[*] Added new tutorials in the menu when accessing the Play, Collection and Deck Edit sections for the first time
[*] Added a daily reward on log in. Each day you log in you will get a predefined reward. 
[*] Renamed Events into Challenges. Added three new challenges, two of which will change each week.
[*] Rookie Challenge - This is a one off challenge intended to allow new players a slower ramp time before they jump into ranked.
[*] Weekly Challenge - This one is similar to the playoff event. Each week a new set of teams will be in the challenge.
[*] Boss Challenge - These are extremely difficult challenges that offer a single opponent and will change each week.
[*] Reworked the back-end purchase flow to make it more resilient and better treat some purchase edge cases.
[/list]

Thank you and good luck!

notes.title: Update v0.5.2b: Passive and Player Tuning
notes.content:
Hey Everyone,

We did a few sever side passive and player changes:

Passive [b]Match Start: Give opponent 1 Tier 2 Defensive Debuff[/b] changed to [b]Match Start: Give opponent 1 Tier 1 Defensive Debuff[/b].
Passive [b]Match Start: Give opponent 1 Tier 2 Offensive Debuff[/b] changed to [b]Match Start: Give opponent 1 Tier 1 Offensive Debuff[/b].

Affected players: Devon Bookr, Bogdan Bogdanovic, Cedin Hosman, Jaben Harby, Arjay Bartett, Cris Lavert, Camm Redish & Vlathko Kancar.

[i]These two passives were creating a small counter synergy on exploit players since they initially applied a Tier 2 debuff. Lower tier debuffs cannot be applied over higher tier ones, and most skills apply tier 1 debuffs. Due to this, there were less triggers overall for exploit themed players.[/i]

[b]Devon Bookr[/b]
Added passive [b]Match End: Shoot all BONUS SHOTS.[/b]

[i]Devon was a bit underwhelming after the last patch due to the anti synergy described above and the loss of Bonus Shots at the end of the match. We're reintroducing this ability just for him since he is designed to be a self contained BS generator and a lot of his power comes from this.[/i]

[b]Camm Redish[/b]
Salary reduced from 14 to 13.

[b]Cris Lavert[/b]
Salary reduced from 16 to 15.

[b]Jaben Harby[/b]
Salary reduced from 10 to 9.

Thank you and good luck!

notes.title: Update v0.5.2: Roster Update, New Ladder Season, Balance Pass & Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Hey Everyone,

In this update, we do a final pass on the season 2 player roster, a major balance pass, and fix a bunch of issues that have affected the game for a while.

[h1][b]General Changes & Fixes[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed and issue that would cause the game to freeze when certain auras interacted;
[*] Fixed visual issue with particles when opening packs;
[*] Fixed pack shadow being visible briefly when opening a pack;
[*] Fixed quest reward text being displayed on two lines instead of one;
[*] Increased rotating shop slot count from 1 to 3;
[*] Updated starter collection based on the new player roster;
[*] Significantly reduced completion threshold for most quests;
[*] Updated team colors for players based on latest transfers;
[*] Added Fame rewards for ladder ranks;
[*] Modified the opponent team from the final match in the tutorial to decrease difficulty.
[/list]

[h1][b]Gameplay Changes[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Bonus Shots and Bonus Passes are no longer thrown at the end of the match;
[*] Players shoot from offensive rebounding even if they are exhausted;
[*] 3 Point Chance has been changed to now be a main attribute of the players. Each player will have a 3P Chance attribute that reflects their real life 3PFGA/FGA percentage. notes.title: Season 2 Preview - Gameplay Changes
notes.content:
Hey Everyone,

With Season 2 fast approaching, we'd like to take the time to go over some of the changes we will be doing to the core mechanics, and the reasoning behind them. 

[h1]Card Type Abilities[/h1]
One of the areas of concern we have with the current gameplay experience is related to the card type abilities:
[list]
[*] Strength - [b]Offensive Rebound: Get +20 TURN METER[/b]
[*] Skill - [b]Activate 2: Shoot 1[/b]
[*] Speed - [b]Activate 2: Pass 1[/b]
[*] Will - [b]Steal: Get +30 TURN METER[/b]
[/list]
Balance wise, the STR and SPD abilities are significantly more powerful than their SKL & WILL counterparts. 

SPD players on average get more activations than SKL players (around 20-25% more) due to their higher native playmaking. Even though the abilities look similar, SPD players trigger theirs more often. The fact that the second trigger requires 4 activations also works against SKL as there are very few players of that archetype that can reliably get to 4 activations in a single match.

STR is the most problematic because it enables chain activations on the same team. How this works is:
[list]
[*] One of your player activates and shoots
[*] You get offensive rebounds on your STR players and they get turn meter
[*] The turn meter they get pushes them over the activations threshold
[*] STR player activates and shoots
[*] More offensive rebounds that push other STR players over the activation threshold
[*] This can repeat several times, allowing 3-5 consecutive activations 
[/list]
Let's call this the Valaciunas paradox. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42984262/13cac2e999fba98eb151c394dbfa7bdd85fa1754.jpg[/img]
The more you shoot, the more offensive rebounds you get. The more offensive rebounds, the more activations you get. The more activations you get, the more you shoot, and so on. Overall, it's not a great experience for anyone playing against it.

When we compare it to the WILL ability, the turn meter boost from stealing occurs on the opponent's turn. This will break the consecutive activation chain, and allow for a more even distribution of the activations. You get the chance to react to what the opponent is doing, which is great for the gameplay experience.

All of this being said, we are happy with the SPD & WILL abilities, but are changing the SKL and STR ones to the following:
[list]
[*] Strength - [b]Defensive Rebound 2: Get +15 TURN METER[/b]
[*] Skill - [b]Shoot: Give opponent +10% FOUL CHANCE this turn[/b]
[/list]

The STR ability is moving to defensive rebounding. It will now act in the same way as the WILL one, in that it will break chain activations for your opponent because it now generates the turn meter on their turn.

For SKL we wanted to try something different. We've been wanting to incorporate fouling into the core experience for a while, and taking this opportunity to do so. Gameplay wise, this makes SKL players more reliable scorers (from extra free throws) compared to the previous version.

[h1]Mismatch/Dominated[/h1]

Another area we though needed improvement was the Mismatch/Dominated matrix and abilities.
Currently we have SKL > SPD > STR > WILL > SKL, and the current bonuses are:
[list]
[*] Strength - [b]+20 OFFENSE & +20 REBOUNDING[/b]
[*] Skill - [b]+30 OFFENSE[/b]
[*] Speed - [b]+20 OFFENSE & +10 PLAYMAKING[/b]
[*] Will - [b]+20 OFFENSE & +10 DEFENSE[/b]
[/list]

One first issues is that the bonuses mismatch gives are too powerful. They are equivalent to three tier 1 buffs. We are toning them down to be equivalent to two tier 1 buffs.

Secondly, the current structure does not make much sense when we consider how the archetypes have evolved. We decided to change the mismatch matrix and abilities as follows:

[b][h3]SPD > SKL[/h3][/b]
SPD players get +10 OFFENSE & +10 PLAYMAKING when facing a SKL players.
SPD player are supposed to be active playmakers. They are the best passers in the game, while SKL has the least steal. They will out activate, out maneuver and out volume their SKL opponents. 

[b][h3]SKL > STR[/h3][/b]
STR players get -10 DEFENSE & -5% BLOCK when facing a SKL players.
SKL players are shooters, with a focus on 3P shots. 3P shots are rarely blocked, and big men don't generally defend well against them.

[b][h3]STR > WILL[/h3][/b]
WILL players get -10 DEFENSE & -15 REBOUNDING when facing a STR players.
WILL players are good defenders, but it's difficult to defend against big men in the paint. Similarly, while WILL players are the 2nd best rebounders in the game, STR players will assert their dominance in rebounding when going for the same ball.

[b][h3]WILL > SPD[/h3][/b]
WILL players get +10 OFFENSE & +7% STEAL when facing a SPD players.
WILL players will shut down the pass focused SPD players more easily. Their native high defense is already good enough to prevent SPD players from scoring, but they need a bit of help on the offensive side to keep up on the scoring side.

All these changes will be available on the steam beta branch starting next week. Details on how to access it will be posted separately.

Thank you for reading, and good luck!

[h1][b]General Changes & Fixes[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]Auras and traits are now disabled when a player is exhausted.[/b] This has long been an issue and allowed things like aura stacking to circumvent Exhausted. Actions based passives are not disabled (eg. Get Bonus Pass on offensive rebounding/steal/miss, etc).
[*] Fixed and issue where MMR was not updating at the correct interval.

[list]

[*] Gold -> Silver 5

notes.title: Update v0.4.0: Ranked mode, Private Lobbies & 57 New Cards
notes.content:
[h1]Ranked Mode[/h1]

Ranked mode is finally here! Here is how it works.

There are 5 divisions: Bronze, Silver, Gold, Diamond and All-Star. The first four divisions consist of 5 sub divisions each.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42984262/ffe1a930f269abf3a8d111e5b1376a34395d2690.png[/img]

Winning a match grants you a star for the current division rank. Winning a match while having 3 stars promotes you to a higher rank/division. Winning consecutive matches grants an extra star, up to the Gold division.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42984262/6fc105f7669085fb6e0058c3776a29b16b26a8c6.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42984262/28e032c69cd2ec25685f4967989c005689bea420.png[/img]
You cannot de demoted once you reach a division. Eg. You cannot go back to Silver after reaching Gold.

When reaching the All-Star division, your MMR rank on the global leader board is displayed instead.


[h1]Private Lobbies[/h1]
You can now play against other players in dedicated lobbies. To do this, both players have to go to the Private tab from Play and select a deck.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42984262/7f6886982117a4b0ad865ae4e65822ef391ce979.jpg[/img]

Both players must enter the same lobby name, then select play to be matched against each other.

notes.title: Update v0.3.6: New Cards & Playoff Challenge Event
notes.content:
This update brings 29 new cards: 3 legendary, 3 epic, 16 rare and 7 common, a new PvE event, and small round of balance changes.

[h1][b]Playoff Challenge Event[/b][/h1]
With the NBA playoffs in full swing, we thought we would join the party with our own challenge event.
Defeat each stage and conquer the playoffs!

[h1][b]Player Changes[/b][/h1]

[b]Dejonte Murrei[/b]
Salary increased from 26 to 28.
Offense increased from 45 to 61.
Added new passive [b]Foul: Get +1 BONUS SHOT[/b]
Replaced second and third skills with two new skills:
[b]Shoot 3 and get +25 TURN METER for each adjacent SPEED teammate. Give your team STEAL UP I.[/b]
[b]Shoot 3 and get +25 TURN METER for each adjacent WILL teammate. Give your team BLOCK UP I.[/b]

[quote]Dejonte was arguably the worst legendary card in the pool, and was in need of a rework. We gave him a large offense boost to improve his scoring capabilities, two new skills that enforce his Will-Speed dual synergy, and a new passive to mitigate the draw back of fouling.[/quote]

[b]Stephon Curri[/b]
Replaced third skill with [b]Switch with a random Winh teammate and Shoot 3. Move to the other wing position and Shoot 3.[/b]

[quote]Stephon did not have a third skill that synergies with his passive kit. This is now fixed, and also provides an extra boost for move decks, that get two new triggers.[/quote]

[b]Jimmi Buttler[/b]
Offense increased from 53 to 58.
Block increased from 6 to 9.
Playmaking increased from 73 to 75.
Stamina increased from 62 to 68.
Replaced second skill with [b]Catch Up Shots[/b] - 5 shots.
Removed passive [b]4th Quarter: Get Clutch Blocker[/b].
Added passive [b]Behind: Get Hustler[/b].

[quote]We felt the need to buff Jimmi to match his real world performance. The addition of Hustler makes him a stats monster when behind, and the addition off Catch Up Shots greatly improves his scoring capabilities.[/quote]

[b]Bizmak Bionbo[/b]
Removed passive [b]Defensive Rebound: Get +10 TURN METER[/b].
Added passive [b]4th Quarter: Get Clutch Blocker[/b].

notes.title: Update v0.3.4: New Cards, Filters Rework & Balance Changes
notes.content:
This update brings 27 new cards: 2 legendary, 6 epic, 12 rare and 7 common, a rework of the collection filters, and a new round of card/mechanics reworks and balance changes.

This update will be live on Thursday, March 30th, in the following interval:

[list]
[*] 10 AM - 10:30 AM CET
[*] 1 AM - 1:30 AM PST
[*] 4 AM - 4:30 AM EST
[*] 5 PM - 5:30 PM China Standard Time
[/list]

One major change we're doing in this update is no longer allowing player activations after the match timer reaches zero. 

As players familiar with the game may know, Bonus Shots/Passes generated after the timer reaches zero are not thrown unless the player who generated them activates. Well, we fixed this for internal testing, and it revealed a deeper problem related to activation post final buzzer. In the current state of the game, with Bonus Shots/Passes generated post buzzer not being thrown, we get 0-4 extra post buzzers activation. With the above mentioned fix in, this quickly got out of hand, and we often had games with 5+ post buzzer activations. 

With all the extra Bonus Shots/Passes there were more opportunities for steals and offensive rebounds, which generate Turn Meter, which generates activations. Each activation generates more opportunities for generating Turn Meter or Bonus Shots/Passes. The cycle repeats too much for our liking, and just feels uncanny. Due to this interaction, we made the decision to remove post buzzer activations. [b]The match will now end immediately after the final buzzer.[/b]

[h1][b]Balance Changes[/b][/h1]

The [b]Skill[/b] archetype passive has been changed from [b]Receive Pass: Get Skilled this turn[/b] into [b]Activate 2: Shoot 1[/b]. 

Skilled granted +10% Accuracy and +20% 3 Point Chance.

[quote]The previous passive was making skill type players outperform massively as pass targets. They were already supposed to be good pass targets due to their native high offense and 3 point chance, so it was a buff to what was already their main strength, while also being completely useless if they did not receive passes.[/quote]

For the [b]Will[/b] archetype, we reinforced their defense focused role. The [b]Stopper[/b] trait, with it's four triggers, has been removed from the majority of non Will players. It is now found mostly on [b]Will[/b] players:

[b][list][*] Exploit Speed: Get Stopper
[*] Exploit Skill: Get Stopper
[*] Exploit Will: Get Stopper
[*] Exploit Strength: Get Stopper[/list][/b]
[b]Stopper[/b] now grants +20 Defense, down from +40 defense.

[quote]We made this chance to ensure there are viable defensive counters to all archetypes. Until now, the best way to counter was through the Mismatch interaction, but for match ups such as skill-speed there were very few options available. Will players as the go to defense solution against all other archetypes.[/quote]

notes.title: Update v0.3.0: Quest System
notes.content:
This update contains the quest system. We initially wanted to include this in last week's release, but it was not ready on time.

It will be live on February 2nd, in the following interval:
[list]
[*] 10 AM - 10:15 AM CET
[*] 1 AM - 1:15 AM PST
[*] 4 AM - 4:15 AM EST
[*] 5 PM - 5:15 PM China Standard Time
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42984262/976471cb89ebcb0336e3005e8a2b2a3f3966da5e.png[/img]

Here is how it works:
[list]
[*] Each day you will get a new daily quest, up to a maximum of 3.
[*] Each week you will get new weekly quests, up to a maximum of 3.
[*] You can re-roll a quest of each type every day.
[*] Each daily quest grants 75 coins. 
[*] Each weekly quest grants 250 coins.
[*] Quests can be completed both by playing against the AI in practice mode, and playing against human opponents.
[/list]

We want quests to be the main way players earn coins, so we have reduced end of match rewards. Playing against the AI now grants 20 coins per win and 10 coins per loss, down from 30/15.
Playing against other players now grants 30 coins per win and 15 coins per loss, down from 50/25.

This may seem like a big hit to coin generation, but in reality the addition of the quest system greatly increased the amount of coins you can generate each week. Assuming someone who played around 30 matches per week, with a 50% win rate, the numbers look like this:

[list]
[*] 50 coins per win, 25 per loss. Average coins per match 37.5. 
37.5*30 = 1125 coins
[*] 30 coins per win, 15 per loss. Average coins per match 22.5. 7 completed daily quest, 3 completed weekly quest. 
22.5*30 = 675 coins + 7*75 = 525 + 250*3 = 750. Total is 1950 for playing the same amount of matches while also completing all quests granted within a week.
[/list]

Thank you and have fun!

[h1][b]Balance Changes[/b][/h1]

Our main goals with this patch was to reduce the power of the buffing and debuffing archetypes, prevent substitute in abuse, and generally bring some of the over performing cards back in line to where we think they should be. To achieve this, we made the following changes.

[b]All passives that had percentage bases proc chances have been reworked to now trigger deterministically.[/b] Here is an example:
[b]Team Buff: 50% chance to get +1 BONUS SHOT[/b] has become [b]Team Buff 4: Get +2 BONUS SHOTS[/b]
What does this mean? Every 4th debuff placed on the opposing team now grants 2 Bonus Shots. This makes the passive more consistent, while also keeping the same average proc chance as before.

[b]Substitute In & Exhausted passives are now once per match effects. [/b]
A big problem with the buff/debuff archetypes was the ability to constantly sub in mass buff/debuff players. This is no longer possible, and comes with the benefit of also fixing a few other sub in abuse strats.

[b]Team based effects that generated a direct shot or pass now generate a Bonus Shot or Bonus Pass instead.[/b] This is a quality of life change that also serves as a nerf to engine type decks like rebounding.

Having shots/passes trigger one at a time extended the duration of the game, without adding any value. Furthermore, engine decks like rebounding were getting triggers that allowed them to keep generating shots/passes continuously during a single activation, which when combined with various players generating turn meter cause two problems:
[list]
[*] Turns were taking a long amount of time. When your opponents did this it felt like you were barely playing the game. Even if the activation count was even, turns for one of the players were taking much longer and gave the feeling that they were playing more than you.
[*] The shot/pass engine type gameplay combined with Turn Meter generation allow multiple consecutive activations for some players. This was actually making them play more. Activations during a match are a limited resources. Having one player get significantly more than the other will often give them an insurmountable advantage.
[/list]
The addition of more Bonus Shots/Passes to the game has an extra indirect benefit, as it also buffs skills that remove the two, since they are now more common than before.

Lastly, [b]we generally reduced offense and/or increased defense for most players[/b]. Until now we treated offense and defense as symmetrical opposites, but offense is actually much stronger than defense because it generates points, while defense does not remove points. Furthermore, defense doesn't even completely negate a shot since it can still be rebounded offensively. After this change offense is still stronger, but by a significantly lower margin.

notes.title: Update v0.2.2: New Cards, Balance Tweaks and Bug Fixes!
notes.content:
The first patch on the new year brings 14 new cards, balance changes and bug fixes.  We have 1 new Legendary, 3 Epics, 7 Rares and 3 Commons.

The patch will be live on December 5th in the following interval:
[list]
[*] 15 PM - 16 PM CET
[*] 6 AM - 7 AM PST
[*] 9 AM - 10 AM EST
[*] 10 PM - 11 PM China Standard Time
[/list]

[h1][b]New Cards[/b][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42984262/72a3a59d2a6f851befe2070fdd4e2b9b2a7c8b78.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42984262/079ef4d07c00878eaa06c462ebb9c3f07a02b3e0.png[/img]
[quote]Iulius Randl is one of the strength archetype build arounds. He has 3 auras, one of which addresses the 
STR weakness of low playmaking. He is also a scorer, which is relatively rare for the STR archetype.
Special gives +30 Rebounding and +30 Playmaking to STR players.
Enforcer gives +5 Block to STR players.
Determined gives +30 Rebounding to any adjacent player.[/quote]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42984262/ee1405037fdfc78b8cf550623893f5a49b283ec8.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42984262/f85adf8d9d6e314f3694712d2bbe52c492af433f.png[/img]
[quote]Dedrick Roze is a buff archetype card, and likely the best buff archetype enabler in the game. He places a total of 7 buffs on sub in, as well as having Bonus Pass generation for himself. He will on average get 3.5 bonus passes when he is subbed in.[/quote]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42984262/affcb54e7361ceb3cbdc2500bb4e1b2ee33209c9.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42984262/4d85b43d98a8e861990a3255955950894faa694d.png[/img]
[quote]Mychael Robinzon is a stats monster. He has a high native block, and blocks against all shots from speed and skill player types, and with Clutch Blocker for a huge blocking boost in the 4th quarter.
Ideally you want to have him as your main pass target, sub him out on the first activation, and get him back in in the 4th quarter.[/quote]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42984262/d634e1b6515d20622df3c744e9faba7435e4abb4.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42984262/bef74bd3b12264bd157f38a1662e09a20b05a5b0.png[/img]
[quote]Jaylen Bronson is another strength shooter, and one of the highest playmaking STR players. Together with Iulius Randl, he is intended to be an addition that makes the STR archetype viable.[/quote]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42984262/f81906e5c958a850772de37305bd97bbc07c6693.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42984262/e8cb388d772200bd2c866ce04f82fd7436daa39b.png[/img]
[quote]Arjay Bartett is another addition to the debuff archetype, but more focused on defense. It should help balance the archetype out, and not have it be all in on offense.[/quote]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42984262/95a49d43cc1eebeef8642ba8ed22fa4281923ff9.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42984262/2b755dda465e91919e1302185555024f38cd36a6.png[/img]
[quote]Camm Redish may look ordinary, but he is one of the few players with the Shutdown passive, which prevents opponents from generating bonus shots/passes.[/quote]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42984262/8bcedb9b777c9a4cbe2832282a632eb975c63653.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42984262/464f0cfb5ee6fd349a226952cd8d5f0f60bcdae0.png[/img]
[quote]Our last special player from this update is Isayah Hartandstein. Another high block player with Teamwork, but he also has Hardened, which gives rebounding and block for each other STR teammate. In a full STR lineup, he has the highest native block in the game at 27.[/quote]

[h1][b]Balance Changes[/b][/h1]

[h3]Players[/h3]
[b]Brando Imgram[/b]
Increased Bonus Shots generated and removed by [b]Mocking Trickshots[/b] from 5 to 6. Now also removes up to 6 Bonus Passes.
Add new passive: Aura: Wing teammates have Wing Defender. Wings are the left most and right most players on the board, and Wing Defender grants +20 Defense.

[b]Ban Adebaio[/b]
Replaced passive: [b]Offensive Rebound: 50% chance to get +50 Turn Meter[/b]
with [b]Offensive Rebound: Switch position with a random teammate[/b]

[quote]Developer Comments:
Ban was a problem in the rebounding deck. Our intent for him was to be a part of the movement archetype. With this change, we reduce the power of the rebounding deck significantly, as well as move Ban more towards movement.[/quote]

[b]Dejonte Murrai[/b]
New passive: Trait: Pacifist. Pacifist makes Dejonte unable to foul while at 5 fouls. He basically cannot be eliminated from the match. If you can get him to 5 fouls, he will be a defensive stats monster.

[b]Anthonny Daviz[/b]
Passive [b]Opportunistic: Get +5 DEFENSE, PLAYMAKING, REBOUNDING or OFFENSE permanently[/b] now grants +10 of each attribute.

[b]Kylle Laoury[/b]
Contact III passive reduced from 30% foul chance on opponent to 20% foul chance.

[b]Kairi Irwing[/b]
Replace passive [b]Exploit: 50% chance to get +1 BONUS SHOT[/b] with [b]Exploit: 50% chance to get +1 BONUS PASS[/b].

[b]Willi Hermangomes[/b]
Replace skill [b]Mastered Post Shots[/b] with [b]Pick & Option[/b].

[b]Nicholas Batoom[/b]
Offense increased from 39 to 44.

[b]Naji Marshall[/b]
Salary decreased from 7 to 5.
Replace passive [b]Team Steal: 50% chance to Shoot 1[/b] with [b]Trait: Direct opponent has Shutdown[/b]. Shutdown prevents opponent from generating bonus shots and passes.

[b]Johnathan Kumingga[/b]
Replace skill [b]Drrible Penetration[/b] with [b]Drive & Press[/b].
Offense increased from 45 to 58.
Playmaking decreased from 42 to 32.
Blocking increased from 0 to 3.

[b]Jalen Johnson[/b]
Rebounding increased from 39 to 49.

[b]Kevan Luney[/b]
Offense increased from 46 to 56.

[b]Justin Holiday[/b]
Replace skill [b]Distribute[/b] with [b]Feed the Cutter[/b]. Pass count set to 4.
Replace skill [b]Volume Shooting[/b] with [b]Feed the Post[/b]. Pass count set to 4.

[b]Gabe Vinccent[/b]
[b]Volume Shooting[/b] shot count increased from 5 to 6.

[b]Nicolas Claxton[/b]
Rebounding increased from 64 to 68.
Blocking increased from 12 to 15.

[b]Bismack Biyombo[/b]
Salary decreased from 7 to 6.

[b]Ceejay Maccolum[/b]
Salary decreased from 21 to 20.
Steal increased from 3 to 6.
Replace passive [b]Miss: 50% chance to Get +1 BONUS PASS[/b] with [b]Miss: Get +7 TURN METER[/b]. 

[b]Tray Yung[/b]
Salary decreased from 21 to 20.
Steal increased from 3 to 6.
Replace passive [b]Miss: Get +10 TURN METER[/b] with [b]Miss: 50% chance to Get +1 BONUS PASS[/b]. 
Replace passive [b]Aura: SPEED teammates have Active[/b] with [b]Aura: SPEED teammates have Fast[/b]. Active granted +10 playmaking, and Fast grants +10 offense.
[b]Make it Rain[/b] skiill cooldown decreased from 3 to 2.

[quote]Developer Comments:
Tray was one of the most overpowered cards. As the cards with the most playmaking in the game, him having direct turn meter generation was overkill, so we removed it. On top of this, him giving Speed teammates playmaking through his Active aura was in conflict with the design intent of him slowing the other players down. We took that out and replaced it with an offense aura. Without these issues fixed, we can revert the nerf to his ultimate cooldown.[/quote]

[b]Jaylen Grinn[/b]
Playmaking increased from 61 to 64.

[b]Marccus Smarrt[/b]
Defense increased from 77 to 81.
Offense increased from 35 to 38.
[b]Drive & Kickount[/b] skill shot/pass count increased from 2 to 3.

[b]Sam Hauser[/b]
3 Point Chance increased from 25 to 30.

[b]Kenba Valker[/b]
Offense increased from 57 to 59.
Playmaking increased from 71 to 73.

[b]Lommie Walkr[/b]
Defense increased from 48 to 55.
Offense increased from 47 to 52.
Playmaking increased from 65 to 66.

[b]Boggdan Boggdanovic[/b]
Salary increased from 16 to 17.

[b]Bones Hylanb[/b]
Salary increased from 9 to 12.

[quote]Developer Comments:
One of the potentially overpowered archetypes is debuff. It can score 200 points on a regular basis, and it's borderline out of hand. We're nerfing the cost of its cheap pieces. People will still be able to build strong debuff decks, but it will be more difficult to fit everything in.

We will make further nerfs in the future to this archetype. Right now we're planning on making some of the substitution debuffs that this deck relies upon to be "once per match" effects, as well as tuning the proc chance for bonus shot/pass generation.[/quote]

[h3]Passives[/h3]
[b]Contact II[/b]
Reduced foul chance from 20% to 15%. Affects the following players: Daivid Nwuaba, Denis Schredder, Nik Richardz, Onyeka Okongwoo

[b]Overpowering Rebounder[/b]
Reduced bonus rebounding from +100 to +60. Affects the following players: Russel Westbruk, Klint Kapela, Omar Yurseven, Jakson Hays.

[quote]Developer Comments:
Another small nerf to the rebounding deck, and somewhat problematic players such as Russel Westbruk.[/quote]

[b]Miss: Get +10 TURN METER[/b]
Reduce Turn Meter to +7 from +10. Affects the following players: Kelliy Oubrre, Russel Westbruk, Tijay Warden, Tray Morphy.

[b]Make: Get +5 TURN METER[/b]
Increased Turn Meter to +7 from +5. Affects the following players: Danillo Gallinnari, Jonaz Valaciunas, Jorrdan Pool, Kevyn Dureant, Tiler Hero.

[h3]Skills[/h3]
[b]Challenge The Lane[/b]
Switch with teammate. Get [strike]+15[/strike] +20 STAMINA and COUNTER ATTACK for 2 turns.
Increased Stamina from +15 to +20.
Affects the following players: Willy Couly-Steyn, Alonzo McKinney.

[b]Bail Out[/b]
CLEANSE all debuffs from a teammate, and give them [strike]+5[/strike] +10 {STAMINA}.
Increased Stamina from +5 to +10.
Affects the following players: Herbal Jonez, Irsh Wainride, Jay Crowdr.

[b]Reposition[/b]
Switch with teammate, and give them [strike]+15[/strike] +20 STAMINA if they are STRENGTH. Shoot X.
Increased Stamina from +15 to +20.
Affects the following players: Ennes Kanttr, De'Andrre Huntr, Iustin Andersun, Daron Sharp, Coby Zelver, Jack Lamdale, Anthonny Daviz.

[b]Use Flexible Screen[/b]
Switch with teammate. Get [strike]+10[/strike] +15 STAMINA and COUNTER ATTACK for 2 turns.
Increased Stamina from +10 to +15.
Affects the following players: Milez Bridgez, Erric Gordn, Dayson Danielz, Saban Li.

[quote]Developer Comments:
We felt stamina skills were in need of a buff to make them more appealing.[/quote]

[b]Improvise[/b]
Changed from [b]Give an opponent two Tier 2 Offensive Debuffs[/b] to [b]Give an opponent two random debuffs for 2 turns.[/b]
Affects the following players: Tare Easton, Draymond Grinn, Blaik Griffith, Trrevor Arisa, 

[quote]Developer Comments:
This will now choose from the entire debuff pool, and all tiers. You can potentially get two tier 3 debuffs, or two tier 0 debuffs.[/quote]

The following players can be disenchanted for full cost:
[list]
[*] Bam Adebayo

[*] Trae Young

[*] Brandon Ingram
[*] CJ McCollum

[*] Trey Murphy
[*] Naji Marshall
[*] Justin Holiday
[*] Dejounte Murray
[/list]

[h1][b]Bug Fixes & Other Changes[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue where steal chance would not count the right most player. If you passed to the left, the player in front of the passer would not steal. If you passed to the right, the player in front of the pass receiver would not steal.
[*] Fixed the tutorial explanation for rebounding to now correctly say that rebounding is doubled while defending.
[*] Player names are now displayed in both upper and lower caps.
[*] Fixed [b]Mocking Trickshots[/b] removing bonus passes instead of bonus shots. Now removes both.
[*] Fixed issue where skills that removed bonus shots/passes would set a player's shot count to a negative value.
[/list]

[h1][b] Not in this patch, but not forgotten[/b][/h1]
Connectivity issues. We're working on it and will hotfix as soon as we can.

Thank you and good luck!

[h1]IN GAME STORE[/h1]

Every game has to make money, and we are no exception. We are offering card pack bundles for purchase. While the game will be in early access, the amount of packs at each tier is greatly increased (around double). 

[h1]MATCHMAKING BOTS & AI IMPROVEMENTS[/h1]

Since it's difficult to find human opponents to play with, we are adding bots to the matchmaking queue. If a human opponent is not found within approximatively 60 seconds, players will be matched with bots. Bot games give the same rewards as games against human opponents.

We will tune this down, or completely retire the bots as our player base increases.

We have improved the AI behavior to prevent it from substituting in fatigued players, and added a lot more decks to the AI pool.
